plain_statement: Number the Petersen graph on ten inputs: outer cycle 0-1-2-3-4-0, spokes 0-5, 1-6, 2-7, 3-8, 4-9, inner edges 5-7, 7-9, 9-6, 6-8, 8-5. The function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true has no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 19 gates. A circuit with 20 gates exists, so the value would be 20, the number of edges plus the least vertex cover minus one.
title: Petersen graph: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 19 gates computes its edge function
